nodes.label: Lock Icon - Locked Content / Access Restriction Indicator
nodes.description: High-resolution (2x) padlock UI icon rendered in solid dark/black color. Classic closed padlock shape with a shackle arc at the top and a circular keyhole in the body. Used as a UI indicator for locked content, restricted access, premium features, or security-related states.
nodes.visual_style: flat solid icon, monochrome dark/black, no outline strokes, suitable for dark or light UI backgrounds at retina resolution
nodes.purpose: Indicates locked, restricted, or premium content in the application UI
